name: tw01-scs-0826-1500
js: const H = 225, sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), lvl = () => { v.director.setHeading(H); v.state.heading = H; v.state.bankDeg = 0; }; const w = v.director.weather; lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(15000); lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(1500); const d = w.describe(); v.director.setActive(false); lvl(); await sleep(3000); lvl(); return d + ' | 砧顶 ' + v.weather.storms.map((s) => s.top.toFixed(1)).join(',');
